import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import scipy.sparse
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Configuration
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
OUTPUT_FILE = f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv"

# Create output directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/test.csv")
sample_df = pd.read_csv(f"{INPUT_DIR}/sample_submission.csv")

# Ensure submission columns match sample order
output_columns = ["id"] + list(sample_df.columns[1:])

# Identify label columns
label_columns = [
    "toxic",
    "severe_toxic",
    "obscene",
    "threat",
    "insult",
    "identity_hate",
]

# Shuffle and split training data
train_shuffled = train_df.sample(frac=1, random_state=42).reset_index(drop=True)
split_idx = int(0.8 * len(train_shuffled))
train_subset = train_shuffled.iloc[:split_idx]
val_subset = train_shuffled.iloc[split_idx:]

# Extract features and labels
X_train_text = train_subset["comment_text"]
X_val_text = val_subset["comment_text"]
y_train = train_subset[label_columns].values
y_val = val_subset[label_columns].values

# Test set text
X_test_text = test_df["comment_text"]
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Extract text statistics features (lightweight: length, words, uppercase)
train_stats = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "len": X_train_text.str.len().astype("float64"),
        "words": X_train_text.str.split().str.len().astype("float64"),
        "upper": X_train_text.str.upper().str.len().astype("float64"),
    }
).fillna(0)

val_stats = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "len": X_val_text.str.len().astype("float64"),
        "words": X_val_text.str.split().str.len().astype("float64"),
        "upper": X_val_text.str.upper().str.len().astype("float64"),
    }
).fillna(0)

test_stats = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "len": X_test_text.str.len().astype("float64"),
        "words": X_test_text.str.split().str.len().astype("float64"),
        "upper": X_test_text.str.upper().str.len().astype("float64"),
    }
).fillna(0)

# Convert stats to sparse matrix
stats_csr = scipy.sparse.csr_matrix(train_stats.values.astype("float64"))
val_stats_csr = scipy.sparse.csr_matrix(val_stats.values.astype("float64"))
test_stats_csr = scipy.sparse.csr_matrix(test_stats.values.astype("float64"))

# Create TF-IDF vectorizer with optimized parameters
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000, ngram_range=(1, 2), stop_words="english"
)
X_train_sparse = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_text)
X_val_sparse = vectorizer.transform(X_val_text)
X_test_sparse = vectorizer.transform(X_test_text)

# Stack sparse text features with sparse stats features
X_train_all = scipy.sparse.hstack([stats_csr, X_train_sparse])
X_val_all = scipy.sparse.hstack([val_stats_csr, X_val_sparse])
X_test_all = scipy.sparse.hstack([test_stats_csr, X_test_sparse])

# Train models for each target column with optimized settings
models = []
validation_aucs = []

for i, col in enumerate(label_columns):
    print(f"Training model for: {col}")
    model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
        objective="binary",
        n_estimators=100,
        learning_rate=0.05,
        random_state=42,
        verbose=-1,
        is_unbalance=True,
        num_leaves=31,
        min_data_in_leaf=20,
    )
    model.fit(X_train_all, y_train[:, i])
    models.append(model)

    # Evaluate on validation set
    val_preds = model.predict_proba(X_val_all)[:, 1]
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_val[:, i], val_preds)
    validation_aucs.append(auc)
    print(f"{col} Validation AUC: {auc:.4f}")

# Calculate mean column-wise ROC AUC
mean_auc = np.mean(validation_aucs)
print(f"Mean Column-wise ROC AUC (Hold-out): {mean_auc:.4f}")

# Generate submission predictions
submission_data = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids})

for i, col in enumerate(label_columns):
    probs = models[i].predict_proba(X_test_all)[:, 1]
    submission_data[col] = probs

# Reorder columns to match sample submission exactly
submission_data = submission_data[output_columns]

# Save submission
submission_data.to_csv(OUTPUT_FILE, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {OUTPUT_FILE}")
